topic_title: Colors and Shapes of Signs, Signals & Pavement Markings
prompt: What is the legal meaning of a solid double yellow line running along the center of a two-way roadway?

options.text: Passing is permitted on the right side if the forward lane is clear
Passing is allowed only during daytime hours with clear visibility
Passing is strictly prohibited in both directions of vehicular travel
Vehicles may use the center area as a permanent travel cruising lane
